description: Call this when the user asks which crypto narrative or sector is leading, about rotation between AI, RWA, DePIN, memecoins, layer 1, layer 2, DeFi or quantum coins, or for a theme index. Returns eight equal-weight fixed-basket indices rebased to 100 on 2025-01-01 with 1d/7d/30d/90d/YTD returns, vs BTC, and the member lists; daily points are omitted unless include_points is true.

include_points.description: boolean, optional: include the daily index points (large)

name: get_theme_indices
title: Crypto narrative indices (AI, RWA, DePIN, meme, L1, L2, DeFi, quantum)
